# Phase 1: Identifier Resolution for CMIP6 (`intake_esgf`)

To query CMIP6 data via `intake_esgf`, plain-language terms in the request must be converted into standardized CMIP6 DRS (Data Reference Syntax) facet identifiers.

---

### 1. Facet Name Vocabulary

When passing search parameters or mapping requests, use the exact ESGF / CMIP6 facet names:

| Parameter / Facet Name | Description | Example Values |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `source_id` | Model / GCM identifier | `"CESM2"`, `"CNRM-CM6-1"`, `"CanESM5"`, `"UKESM1-0-LL"`, `"MPI-ESM1-2-HR"` |
| `experiment_id` | Simulation experiment | `"historical"`, `"ssp126"`, `"ssp245"`, `"ssp585"`, `"piControl"`, `"1pctCO2"`, `"abrupt-4xCO2"` |
| `variable_id` | Physical variable name | `"tas"`, `"pr"`, `"tasmax"`, `"tasmin"`, `"tos"`, `"sos"`, `"zg"`, `"fgco2"`, `"nbp"` |
| `table_id` | MIP table / temporal domain | `"Amon"`, `"day"`, `"Omon"`, `"Lmon"`, `"3hr"`, `"fx"` |
| `member_id` / `variant_label` | Realization/ensemble identifier (`r<R>i<I>p<P>f<F>`) | `"r1i1p1f1"`, `"r1i1p1f2"`, `"r2i1p1f1"` |
| `institution_id` | Modeling institute | `"NCAR"`, `"CCCma"`, `"MOHC"`, `"IPSL"`, `"MIROC"` |
| `grid_label` | Grid resolution / type | `"gn"` (native grid), `"gr"` (regridded), `"gr1"` |

*Note on `variant_label` vs `member_id`:* In CMIP6 DRS and `intake_esgf`, `member_id` is the facet column name representing the variant label (`r1i1p1f1`).

---

### 2. Common Variable Lookups (`variable_id`)

| Request Concept / Variable | `variable_id` |
| :--- | :--- |
| Near-Surface Air Temperature (2m temperature) | `tas` |
| Daily Maximum Near-Surface Temperature | `tasmax` |
| Daily Minimum Near-Surface Temperature | `tasmin` |
| Precipitation rate | `pr` |
| Sea Surface Temperature | `tos` |
| Sea Surface Salinity | `sos` |
| Geopotential Height | `zg` |
| Air Temperature at multi-level | `ta` |
| Surface Downwelling Shortwave Radiation | `rsds` |
| Net biome productivity (carbon emissions from land) | `nbp` |
| Surface downward flux of total CO2 (carbon emissions to ocean) | `fgco2` |

---

### 3. Common Table ID Lookups (`table_id`)

| MIP Table | Realm & Time Resolution |
| :--- | :--- |
| `Amon` | Atmosphere, Monthly mean |
| `day` | Atmosphere / Ocean / Land, Daily mean |
| `Omon` | Ocean, Monthly mean |
| `Lmon` | Land Surface, Monthly mean |
| `3hr` | 3-Hourly data |
| `fx` | Fixed (time-invariant) data (e.g., land mask `sftlf`, cell area `areacella`) |

---

### 4. Common Experiment Lookups (`experiment_id`)

| Experiment Description | `experiment_id` |
| :--- | :--- |
| Historical climate simulation (1850–2014) | `historical` |
| Pre-industrial control | `piControl` |
| 1% per year CO2 increase | `1pctCO2` |
| Abrupt 4x CO2 increase | `abrupt-4xCO2` |
| SSP1-2.6 (Shared Socioeconomic Pathway 1, low emissions) | `ssp126` |
| SSP2-4.5 (Middle of the road) | `ssp245` |
| SSP3-7.0 (Regional rivalry) | `ssp370` |
| SSP5-8.5 (High emissions) | `ssp585` |

---

### 5. Resolution Directives

- **Case Sensitivity:** All identifiers are strictly case-sensitive (`"tas"` not `"TAS"`, `"Amon"` not `"amon"`, `"historical"` not `"Historical"`).
- **Omissions:** If a facet (e.g., `member_id`, `grid_label`, `table_id`) is not specified in the request, **do not supply a default**. Leaving it out allows the search to query across all available members and grids.
